mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.id AS projectId, p.name AS title, NULL AS body, NULL AS sub, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM project p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT pv.id AS id, pv.project_id AS projectId, pv.id AS projectVersionId, pv.source_file_name AS title, NULL AS body, CONCAT('V', pv.version_number) AS sub, pv.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM project_version pv JOIN project p ON p.id = pv.project_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND pv.source_file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY pv.updated_at DESC, pv.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT kc.id AS id, pv.project_id AS projectId, kc.project_version_id AS projectVersionId, kc.relative_path AS title, kc.content AS body, NULL AS sub, kc.created_at AS updatedAt, MATCH(kc.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS relevance FROM knowledge_chunk kc JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = kc.project_version_id JOIN project p ON p.id = pv.project_id WHERE kc.user_id = #{userId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND MATCH(kc.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY relevance DESC, kc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS id, s.id AS sessionId, s.title AS title, s.target_role AS body, s.interviewer_name_snapshot AS sub, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM interview_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.target_role LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id AS id, t.session_id AS sessionId, t.turn_no AS turnNo, s.title AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(t.question, ''), ' ', COALESCE(t.answer, '')) AS body, CONCAT('第', t.turn_no, '题') AS sub, t.created_at AS updatedAt FROM interview_turn t JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND (t.question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.answer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS id, r.session_id AS sessionId, s.title AS title, CONCAT('总分 ', COALESCE(r.total_score, 0), ' · ', COALESCE(r.hiring_recommendation, '')) AS body, NULL AS sub, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM interview_report r JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'REPORT_READY' AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.target_role LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id AS id, CONCAT(a.company, ' · ', a.role) AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.jd_summary, ''), ' ', COALESCE(a.note, '')) AS body, a.stage AS sub, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM job_application a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.archived = 0 AND (a.company LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.role LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.jd_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id AS id, p.id AS projectId, f.project_version_id AS projectVersionId, f.title AS title, f.content AS body, CONCAT('V', pv.version_number, ' · ', f.fact_type) AS sub, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM project_fact f JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = f.project_version_id JOIN project p ON p.id = pv.project_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND f.confirmation_status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND (f.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ip.id AS id, ip.name AS title, CONCAT_WS(' ', ip.description, ip.topic_mode, CAST(ip.focus_tags_json AS CHAR)) AS body, CASE WHEN ip.built_in = 1 THEN '内置' ELSE '我的' END AS sub, ip.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM interviewer_profile ip WHERE (ip.user_id IS NULL OR ip.user_id = #{userId}) AND ip.archived = 0 AND (ip.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ip.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ip.topic_mode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(ip.focus_tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY ip.built_in DESC, ip.updated_at DESC, ip.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id AS id, t.title AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(t.topic, ''), ' ', t.title) AS body, CONCAT(t.status, ' · ', t.source_type) AS sub, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM study_task t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND (t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.topic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS id, c.title AS title, CONCAT_WS(' ', c.when_to_use, c.content, CAST(c.tags_json AS CHAR)) AS body, CONCAT(c.category, ' · 本事库') AS sub, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM craft_note c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.when_to_use LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(c.tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY c.pinned DESC, c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
